name: Plain
summary: Customer support platform for B2B teams.

flows.title: View all threads for a customer
steps: Open any thread in Plain, then find the customer's name near the top of the customer section in the right-hand sidebar.
Click the name to open the customer's profile page, which lists every thread for that customer across Todo, Snoozed and Done; you can filter and sort these threads the same way as any queue.
For quick context without leaving the thread, check the Recent threads section in the sidebar, which shows the customer's five most recent threads.

flows.title: Assign a thread
steps: Plain automatically assigns a thread to you as soon as you begin typing in it.
To assign it yourself, press A while viewing the thread, use Cmd+K, or select an assignee from the top-right of the thread view.
You can add more than one assignee to a thread: one lead, plus optional co-assignees.

flows.title: Apply a label to a thread
steps: Click Labels in the thread sidebar.
Search for or select a label from the list; applying a label also applies any of its parent labels automatically.

flows.title: Reply to a thread
steps: Press R while viewing a thread to focus the composer.
Type your reply, then press Cmd+Enter to send it, or Cmd+Shift+Enter to send it and mark the thread Done.
